_comment: Source WitcheryWorldGenerator.generateDreamworld places one cotton patch in ~75% of dream chunks (random.nextInt(4) != 0). Vanilla placement can't express 75% via rarity_filter (1/N only), so we place it in every eligible chunk and match the source's expected density through the patch tries instead (~0.75 * 64 source tries ~= 48). Previously a rarity_filter chance:4 made it 1-in-4 chunks, i.e. ~3x too rare.
